Name: Infinite Zoom
Author: berkay2578
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Still works as of March 2026![/size][/b][/center]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4P4nbwQ/about.png[/img]
Infinite Zoom lets you change zoom and UI scale levels infinitely! Well, sort of. You can go down to 25% and up to 250% (Originally 75%-200% in the game). [font=Comic Sans MS][size=1][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8808?tab=files#file-container-optional-files]Or down to 5% and up to 10000% with ChunkyZoom™![/url][/size][/font]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Vgy1wLs/how-to-install.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into "[i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]".
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Enjoy the wonders of modern technology!
[*][size=1]Endorse the mod if you liked it. :)[/size]
[/list]
Check out my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3782]Ship Anything[/url]! It lets you sell ANYTHING (boots, rings, tools,weapons, furniture, wallpapers, etc.) using the shipping bin.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/g9GG0Xx/technical-stuff.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Works with the latest version of Stardew Valley (v1.6).
[*]Works with existing saves.
[*]Works in both single-player and multiplayer.
[/list][url=https://github.com/berkayylmao/StardewValleyMods]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ssv0c69/source-code.png[/img][/url]﻿
